instruction: Set the desktop wallpaper to /home/user/Desktop/wallpaper_demo.png so gsettings reports it as the active picture-uri.

evaluator.eval: exact_match(get_vm_command_line(env, config={'command': 'gsettings get org.gnome.desktop.background picture-uri', 'shell': True}), get_rule(env, config={'rules': {'expected': "'file:///home/user/Desktop/wallpaper_demo.png'"}}))
